description:
Functional specifications / files: lib/zaq/channels/delivery/ (new focused result/error contracts only as needed), existing Plan/Step and Preparation contracts; extend module docs rather than adding speculative abstractions. Define executor input as separate Outgoing, Plan, selected connection and trusted runtime dependencies. Define stable original attachment indices, step/group IDs, confirmed receipts, uploaded-only references, failed/unconfirmed facts and unattempted steps. Report raw provider errors privately; project bounded safe evidence for Engine. Confirmation is authoritative; partial failure evidence supplements it. No raw bytes or execution plan crosses reporting boundary.
Tests to add before implementation: contract examples and properties for stable indices, confirmation versus uploaded-only, rejected versus uncertain, content-free safe projections, invalid dependency references and cycles before effects. Preserve old contracts for callers without grouped evidence.
Branches validated: full/partial/no confirmations, configuration/preparation/upload/publication failure, prior streamed message, malformed evidence. Design exact bounded schema before implementation and record it here, including association to persisted answer and connector scope.
Mocking plan: pure tests, no mocks; use domain fixtures for Records.
Documentation: module contracts and docs/services/channels.md / engine.md as ownership requires.
Action reuse: local-only execution infrastructure; reuse Plan/Step, Outgoing, Preparation and existing DeliveryConfirmation evidence semantics. Existing NotifyUsers is a consumer-level notification Action, not an execution runtime; no new Action/tool. Inputs carry trusted actor; no nil-identity bypass or implicit retries. Verification is the contract suite and downstream real-boundary integration.

Implementation rules: Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md plus the owning service guide before work. Reference ../zaq-feat-channel-files is behavioral evidence, not code to copy wholesale. Preserve Outgoing.attachments and separate metadata-only Plan; PR2 FileSettings/resolver remain authoritative. Keep existing test behavior unless its exact change is explicitly approved; add new tests for the new grouped evidence contract. No PR6 Agent selection/AttachDocuments or PR7 workflow/notification implementation. Unit/integration/property/LiveView tests are immediate; new feature E2E belongs to the gated finalization task. Validation follows docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; no per-step numerical coverage gate.

comments.text: Pre-implementation source audit while environment setup runs: Plan and Plan.Step own only metadata and original indices; Attachments.plan_steps produces upload dependencies and independent send/edit metadata. Preparation.acquire owns trusted redemption and byte validation. DeliveryConfirmation remains the reporter and MessageDelivery owns exact persisted input/answer/origin validation; legacy safe_observation is private and confirmation-dominant, so grouped evidence needs a separate typed allowlisted contract alongside it. NotifyUsers is an Engine notification consumer, not the Channel runtime. Keep bridge preparation/provider effects outside these pure contracts. No production/test edits started; environment zaq-9j8.1 still gates implementation. Next contract work must record exact bounds/association schema before tests/implementation, preserving SMTP transport selection versus origin connector identity.

Contract design for implementation once environment gate passes:
- Keep Executor inputs separate: Outgoing, metadata Plan, selected connection, bridge/runtime dependencies. No wrapper or plan field on Outgoing.
- Extend Plan with pure structural validation against original attachment count: unique group/step IDs, fixed original refs, valid dependencies, no cycles, and valid send/edit/upload intent before effects. Reuse Attachments requirements/group checks rather than duplicating size/configuration logic.
- Channel-local Result/Error contracts retain ordered step outcomes, actual confirmed publication receipts and actual delivered attachment refs, uploaded-only references, preparation/configuration failures and unattempted facts. Raw provider causes stay private and excluded from Inspect/projection. A confirmed text fallback never confirms discarded attachments.
- Proposed safe evidence v1: attempt UUID, confirmed-message count, failed parts carrying stable group/step identifiers, original attachment refs, operation/stage, failed/unconfirmed/unattempted outcome, allowlisted reason and optional integer provider code 0..999. No payloads, Records, handles, prepared requests, raw causes or provider response maps. Bound projection to 128 failed parts and 128 refs per part, retaining explicit omitted counts; retain full evidence privately. Upload success alone never creates a confirmed publication.
- Existing DeliveryConfirmation will attach persisted assistant/user UUIDs and origin channel_config_id from trusted Outgoing context; Engine continues exact ownership/scope validation. Selected SMTP transport identity must not replace origin connector identity. Missing persisted association cannot trigger a provider resend.
- Preserve every legacy confirmation-dominance expectation; add standalone contract/property tests. Finalize precise names against implementation, keeping this schema and boundaries. No source/test changes yet; zaq-9j8.1 is still active.
